object_description: compact stacked sports volume with overlapping halls and staggered roof
design_condition: The small volume is placed behind the existing tree row along the driveway, aligned parallel to the existing hall, and set at a respectful distance from the neighborhood, while producing a south-facing forecourt and large sealed parking areas.

positive.statement: The minimal intervention and small footprint preserve a respectful relationship with the existing situation and neighborhood.

position.rationale: Compact footprint and parallel stacked mass are visible beside a defined south forecourt.

positive.statement: The staggered roof creates a volumetric relationship with the existing sports hall.

position.rationale: Staggered upper roof lines are clearly visible in top and elevation views.

positive.statement: The open central nave, lit by skylight strips, has highly valued spatial qualities and flexible potential.

position.rationale: Central longitudinal volume is inferred between the parallel visible hall bands.

positive.statement: The supporting structure is stringent, carefully designed, and sensibly placed to avoid use restrictions.

position.rationale: Repeated structural point rows are visible across the elevations.

positive.statement: The project achieves good economic viability through a deep floor area and small building volume.

position.rationale: Economic judgment has no specific geometric anchor.

positive.statement: The facade expression is appropriately balanced between restraint and independence.

position.rationale: South elevation provides the clearest sampled facade surface for the overall expression.

positive.statement: The very low glazing proportion results in low maintenance and repair costs.

position.rationale: Sparse facade point bands visibly support a low-glazing interpretation.

positive.statement: The extra-high studio with display storage provides an interesting addition to the other school rooms.

position.rationale: Upper-level room is not distinguishable internally, so it is anchored within the taller rear volume.

negative.statement: The extensive homogeneous sealed areas offer little apparent quality of stay.

position.rationale: South-side forecourt and adjacent low surface region provide the likely sealed-area anchor.

negative.statement: The green spaces are too small in the overall context, with insufficient biodiversity and height variation.

position.rationale: Small peripheral landscape areas are approximated along the south-west site edge.

negative.statement: The entrance and external escape staircase are spatially and functionally too modest, with the latter insufficiently dimensioned.

position.rationale: South-facing access edge is visible, but individual entrance and stair elements are unresolved.

negative.statement: The open spatial effect of the central nave conflicts with its possible use as storage or a project room.

position.target: central nave storage or project room
position.rationale: The same central longitudinal volume anchors the conflicting use assessment.

negative.statement: Decentralized access produces sometimes long and complicated routes.

position.rationale: Multiple visible hall bands suggest distributed circulation, without identifiable interior routes.

negative.statement: The sports facilities are functional but not very inviting, and athletes must walk around the equipment room to reach the hall.

position.rationale: Hall zone is located within the elongated lower mass; equipment-room routing is not visible.

negative.statement: The arrangement of staff preparation rooms and cloakrooms is operationally unsatisfactory.

position.rationale: Support spaces are approximated along the lower side of the sampled building mass.

negative.statement: Large spans create concentrated loads and comparatively complex foundations.

position.rationale: Broad repeated spans are visible, while foundations remain below the sampled geometry.

negative.statement: The main entrance lacks seating and shade and does not support its important social meeting function.

position.rationale: South forecourt edge is the plausible anchor for the entrance social area.

negative.statement: The exterior design remains schematic and lacks sensitivity in dealing with the neighborhood.

position.rationale: Peripheral south-west site edge represents the unresolved landscape and neighborhood interface.
